_doc: Curated, hand-editable timing decisions applied by tools/extract/map-timings.mjs. Hand-edit this file; never edit data/actionable-times.json (generated). Two independent sections. `pinnedMontage` forces which candidate animation a skillMap key resolves to, for cases where several animations legitimately fire the same damage id and no automatic signal separates them — the value must be an exact montage path from data/bullet-timings.json, and a path that matches no candidate is reported as an error rather than ignored. `needsStateModel` marks keys whose correct timing depends on a character state the sim does not model yet; the extracted value is kept as provisional and the alternatives are preserved in the entry's `variants` array, so the state model can select between them later without re-deriving anything.
_decidedBy: maintainer walkthrough, 2026-07-29 — see docs/TIMING_MODEL.md 'Choosing between candidate animations'

forte_heavy_ha_conjuration.why: Ground authoring. Same bullet 110501201 ('派生重击1', derived heavy attack 1) as AM_Attack05_Air and both end at 1.1799s, but the ground version has NO cancel window, so she is committed for the full 1.18s. Conjuration derives from Basic Stage 3 or from her Skill, both ground actions. The air variant's 0.567s cancel is not available to a ground rotation.

intro_yo_it_s_big_boomin_time.why: Cast from Huntress (pistol), switching to Guts (shotgun). AM_QTE_S fires 'QTE手枪切霰弹…' = pistol→shotgun; AM_QTE_M fires 'QTE霰弹切手枪…' = shotgun→pistol. Independently confirmed by the damage-id split (7 of this key's ids reach AM_QTE_S, 1 reaches AM_QTE_M). Also carries the correct 1.600s freeze rather than 1.051s.

intro_hey_leadhead_come_n_get_me.why: Cast from Guts (shotgun), switching to Huntress (pistol) — the 'QTE霰弹切手枪' shotgun→pistol bullet. Pinned to keep it stable against the AM_QTE_M_Start02 twin (identical timing) and against the other intro's ids.

liberation.why: The Liberation cast. AM_R_QTE fires the same '大招特效' bullet but has NO freeze; AM_Burst01 freezes 2.2124s across essentially its whole 2.2093s length, the standard Liberation cinematic lock. Without this pin her Liberation extracts no freezeTime and silently falls back to HARDCODED_FREEZE_FRACTIONS. Her intro is separately and correctly on AM_SkillQte.

forte_heavy_umbra_lifetaker_damage.why: Lifetaker replaces the Resonance SKILL (Wingblade), and this montage fires '强化技能1/2-使用' = enhanced SKILL 1/2. It was resolving to AM_Ex_Skill01_02, which fires '强化重击-第二段' = enhanced HEAVY attack stage 2 — that is Thwackblade, a different move.

forte_heavy_umbra_thwackblade_damage.why: Thwackblade is the Heavy Attack follow-up after Enhanced Heavy Attack, matching the '强化重击-第二段' (enhanced heavy attack, stage 2) bullet. Pinned so it stays put now that Lifetaker has moved off this montage.
